PAY v0.5 — bounded, evidence-grounded report for “Bomberland (preview)” (INIT=$1000, PLAY=$1003)

Scope/limits
- This is one code batch (Annotated Disassembly 1/4) plus the provided runtime evidence. Only executed paths/events here are analyzed. No claim of complete song coverage.
- All observations come from the bounded NMOS 6502 model; CIA/VIC/ROM/analog SID are not emulated. Unknown/truncated opcode $0F at $1497 halted further static scanning.

Code regions and evidence (purpose; confidence; exact PCs)
- $1000-$1005
  - $1000 JMP $10F1 (EXEC 1×): INIT entry. High confidence.
  - $1003 JMP $1126 (EXEC 300×): PLAY wrapper. High confidence.
- $10F1-$10FA INIT patcher
  - $10F1 STA $10F6; ASL/ADC; STA $1129 (patch) then RTS. Live patch: $10F7→$1129 FF→00 once; overwritten again at $113E (FF). High confidence.
- $1126-$1160 PLAY prologue / one-time clear
  - $1126 LDX #$00; $1128 LDY #$FF (live variants FF×299, 00×1); BMI $1161 except first frame. First-frame path ($112C…$115E) clears/initializes $14AC..$14DB then jumps to $13F9 (not in this batch). Includes a single SID write at $1135 → $D415=$00. High confidence.
- $1161-$11C4 global filter/mode/volume scheduler + table walker
  - $1161 LDY #imm with live variants {00,01,03,04,05,06,07,0D,0F}; controls subsequent table-driven parameter work. High confidence from live variants.
  - $1165 LDA #imm with many live variants; branch to $118C or $1169 splits control. High confidence.
  - $1169 LDA $1791,Y; BEQ $1180 else path via $1170..$117F/$119E: reads $17B3/$1792 tables, patches $11B5/$11B0, may fall into $119E. High confidence (executed).
  - $1180/$1183 loads $17B3,Y; STA $11AB (patch). $11AB is then used as running accumulator (see $118C..$1196). High confidence.
  - $1189 STA $1166 (patch) sets a countdown used by $118C loop. High confidence.
  - $118C..$1196 ACCUMULATION LOOP: LDA $17B3,Y; ADC $11AB; STA $11AB; DEC $1166; loop via BNE $11AC. This is self-modifying data used to build a control value; ran 160×. High confidence (patch log).
  - $119B/$119E compares $1792,Y and advances Y; $11A7 stores to $1162 (patch). High confidence.
  - $11AA LDA #imm (many values incl 30,C0,14,0E,FA,02,00…); $11AC stores to $D416 (filter cutoff high). $11AF LDA #imm (41,F0,F1,00…); $11B1→$D417 (resonance/routing). $11B4 LDA #imm (10,40,00); ORA #$0F; $11B8→$D418 (mode/volume). These are the only global SID writes (299× each) during PLAY. High confidence (sidSources and writes).
- $11BB-$11E3 per-voice frame sequencer
  - For X={0,7,0E} (voices 1..3), $11C5..$11E1 decrements $14D9,X; if expired, reloads from $14D8,X or alternates via $14AA,Y; then JMP $128C. This is the voice tick length/step and pattern-step feeder. High confidence (executed 897×; branches tallied).
- $11E4-$121F pattern/stream reader + indirection
  - $11E4 LDY $14B1,X; LDA $1495,Y; patches $1281/$128A (55× observed same constant 09). These appear to be “command dispatch selector(s)” later used at $1280/$1289 (see below). Medium-high confidence (patch + later dynamic JSR variants).
  - If $14AF,X==0: load a (FD,FE) pointer pair from tables $15D5/$15DE indexed by $14D6,X, then Y=$14AC,X and fetch byte(s) via LDA ($FD),Y; with FF=escape to 16-bit index. Writes result to $14D7,X and updates $14AC,X. High confidence (indirect read sites at sourcePC=$1205 match).
  - $1219 loads $16A1,Y into $1505,X (follow-on per-step parameter). High confidence.
- $1280/$1289 dynamic command dispatcher (not fully printed in this batch; inferred from live variants)
  - ChangedInstructionVariants show at $1280 JSR to $1009/$1031/$1058; at $1289 JSR to $1009/$1043/$1031/$100F. These invoke helper routines that self-mod state ($11AB/$11B0, $14D8/DF/E6, etc.). High confidence (changedInstructionVariants).
  - Helper routines:
    - $1009 LDA $167F,Y; JMP $1016: copies table byte into $14C2,X and mirrors from $14B1,X→$14C1,X. High confidence.
    - $100F..$1015 clears $14EB,X then stores accumulator into $14C2,X via $1016. High confidence (runtime-only path).
    - $1031..$1039 stores to $14C6/$14C7 (two-byte param), likely target frequency delta or pulse width target. Medium confidence (context).
    - $1043 STA $11AB (patch) and RTS; used 10× for immediate accumulator override. High confidence.
    - $1058..$1069 conditional store to $14D8,$14DF,$14E6 (with sign-strip via AND #$7F): per-voice tick reloads/step durations. High confidence (executed).
- $106A-$10EB portamento/slide engine (per-voice)
  - Entry via $1305 JMPs (see below), toggling between two branches depending on $14C1 comparison and accumulator flags. High confidence (executed).
  - Uses $14EC,X as countdown; when zero, fetches a signed command from $17D6,Y (masked by #$7F into $108B), adjusts and accumulates a signed slope into $14EB,X with two’s-complement handling ($1085..$1095). This slope is then applied to $14EE/$14EF (two-byte frequency) either by add ($10C4 path: ADC $FD/$FE) or subtract ($10DB path: SBC $FD/$FE). The (FD,FE) pair came from $11F5..$1200. This is direct evidence of per-frame pitch slides/portamento. High confidence (executed math and memory roles).
  - Decision points:
    - $10A0 LDA $14C1,X; CMP #$02; BCC $10C4; BEQ $10DB else run $10A9..$10D4 comparing target/current via $1515/$1575 tables and $FD/$FE; falls through to $10EB (load $14DA,X and JMP $130F). Medium confidence for “compare-to-target” behavior (tables read, sign logic, BCC/BMI edges).
- $1305 dynamic JMP target
  - $1305 executed with variants JMP $1070 (count 543) or JMP $10A0 (count 42). This is the voice-rate branch selector between simple accumulate/apply ($1070→$106D→$1324/1321) vs compare-to-target path ($10A0..). High confidence (changedInstructionVariants).

Musical dependencies: code/table → SID write/state
- Global filter/mode/volume (SID $D416/$D417/$D418)
  - Set every PLAY frame by $11AA..$11B8 with values derived from the $1161..$11A7 table walker and $11AB/$1162/$1166 patches:
    - $11AB (accumulator) is built by $118C loop using $17B3,Y plus prior $11AB; also overridden at $1043/$1183. Evidence: patches to $11AB from $1193 (160×), $1183 (86×), $1043 (10×).
    - $1166 is a down-counter controlling how long to keep accumulating into $11AB. Evidence: $1189 stores and $1196 DEC (160×).
    - $1162 stores the final selection byte from $1792/$17B3 to guide the next state. Evidence: $11A7 patch (107×).
    - $11B0 (routing/resonance aux) is patched at $1177 (19×) and cleared at $1138. Evidence: patches list.
  - These drive audible SID filtering/volume on a C64; for AY, this will be dropped/approximated (see below).
- Per-voice frequency and control
  - The frame committers at $13FF/$1405/$140B/$1411/$1417/$1422/$1428 write voice regs in order (900 writes each; all frames). Confidence high via sidSources.
  - Frequency words live in $14EE/$14EF (updated by $10C4/$10DB), then written to $D400/$D401 (V1), $D407/$D408 (V2), $D40E/$D40F (V3) by the commit loop. High confidence.
  - Control register per voice ($D404/$D40B/$D412) toggled with combined waveform bits. Observed events:
    - Many GATE_ON_NO_WAVEFORM on V1/V2/V3 (e.g., frame 7 V1 ctrl=9 gate=1 waveforms=[]), which are not notes per contract.
    - Pitched-state candidates where GATE was already high and a tonal waveform becomes active with nonzero freq:
      - Frame 7 V3: ctrl=$91 (TRIANGLE+NOISE), freqWord=2501 (ayPeriod=435). Evidence: event type NOTE_ON_CANDIDATE.
      - Frame 8 V2: ctrl=$41 (PULSE), freqWord=1874 (ayPeriod=580). Event PITCHED_STATE_ENTERED.
      - Frame 9 V1: ctrl=$51 (TRIANGLE+PULSE), freqWord=937 (ayPeriod=1161). Event PITCHED_STATE_ENTERED.
      - Later similar at frames 17/18/19/28/29/38/39 (see eventSamples). We do not assert “note on” beyond candidate classification.
    - GATE_OFF observed on all voices at times (e.g., frame 15 V1/V2, frame 20 all). These are firm events. High confidence (events).
- Per-voice tick/step control
  - $14D9,X counts down; reload from $14D8,X (or toggled) at expiry; values set via $1058/$1066 or from $14AA table. This controls how often the decoder fetches new stream bytes and/or applies pitch steps. High confidence.
- Indirect data reads (source of music stream/tables)
  - $1205 LDA ($FD),Y with (FD,FE) from $15D5/$15DE via $14D6,X: 12 indirect reads observed (frame-ordered), with FF-escape handling. This is a per-voice pattern/command stream. High confidence (observedDecoderSequences).
  - Additional stream/table reads clustered at PCs $1385/$1397/$13A7/$13AF/$13EC (dec: 4997/5031/5047/5055/5100): these are index+Y reads into ranges $6527..$7441 and $6587..$6667 etc., matching the “decoder layer” that sets up $1281/$128A and dispatches to $1280/$1289 helpers. High confidence (indirectReadSites + observedDecoderSequences).

Flow/loop hypotheses (explicitly tied to observed edges; confidence)
- Overall PLAY loop: $1126 → (first frame: clear) → $11AA..$11B8 (globals) → per-voice $11C5..$11E1 → $128C/$1283 dispatch → $1305 → $1070 or $10A0 → $1321/$1324 → back. Confirmed by branches:
  - $1305 JMP $1070 (543×) or $10A0 (42×). Confirmed.
  - $11C5 DEC … BPL/BEQ edges into $11E4 (expired) vs $128C (active). Confirmed.
- Portamento/slide vs step-to-target: The $10C4 add vs $10DB subtract paths apply (FD,FE) to the current freq; the $10A0 path uses $14C1 compare and tables at $1515/$1575 as threshold/target references before choosing add/sub or jump to $10EB. Hypothesis medium: exact targeting thresholds not fully decoded, but add/sub mechanics are confirmed.
- External conditions:
  - Many decisions depend on table bytes from $1791/$1792/$17B3 and stream bytes fetched indirectly; exact musical grammar remains unknown (by contract).

AY/PAY simplifications (retain/remove/approximate; tradeoffs)
- Retain on AY:
  - Three melodic/noise channels mapped 1:1: SID V1→AY A, V2→AY B, V3→AY C (as planned).
  - Pitch words: convert observed SID freqWord to AY period via tool’s ayPeriod at frame events. Preserve per-voice portamento by applying per-frame period deltas as in $10C4/$10DB semantics.
  - Gate on/off semantics: use AY mixer enable/disable per channel; approximate ADSR with software volume envelopes (simple attack/decay tables), since SID ADSR writes are frequent but AY has only 4-bit volume.
- Approximate or drop:
  - SID filters ($D415-$D418): drop. Replace with static AY volume scaling per “modeVolume” if desired; note that $11B8 varies lower nybble volume, which we can loosely map to a master attenuation.
  - Waveforms: map TRIANGLE/SAW/PULSE combos to AY square; NOISE-only to AY noise; triangle+noise or triangle+pulse+noise cannot be faithfully reproduced—choose square+optional noise gating. Document that pulse width modulation (SID $D402/$D403 etc.) cannot be replicated; emulate with a slow volume LFO if essential.
  - Combined waveforms and TEST/SYNC/RING are not on AY; ignore except NOISE bit.

- Many command dispatches at $1280/$1289 remain only partially sampled; request a longer trace to:

  - Extend framesCompleted beyond 300 to see complete high-level loop/repeat and confirm or refute periodic state-graph cycles reported as uniqueSoundStates=160.
